title: Strengthen native relay ACK cursor and refusal regression controls
outcome: Association-loss ACK regressions prove their cursor snapshot contains the intended participant rows, and a valid ACK demonstrates the observer detects advancement; invalid receipt and mismatched-home controls identify their refusal path.
acceptance: The association-loss regressions assert both intended participant rows are present before comparing unchanged cursors.
A successful ACK control reads the recipient cursor before and after acknowledgement and proves it advances to the issued message sequence.
Invalid-receipt and mismatched-home controls distinguish their expected refusal from missing-association re-resolve refusal; focused behavioral regressions pass.
